name: PR detail Files changed tab renders the seeded Smart Diff
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab (Smart view is default) and confirm the Core group plus seeded paths render: src/middleware/ratelimit.ts (core) and src/config.ts (wiring). Seed has no lockfile — do not assert boilerplate/lockfiles. Exercises DiffTab Smart grouping and the diff-viewer (DiffViewer → FileCard → CodeLine). Read-only seeded data (no model call, do not click Run Review). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
